title: Seven estimates gone quiet: what a follow-up list shows (sample)
description:
A walk through a sample stale-estimate list for an invented remodeling company, the report the pilot makes for contractors: quiet estimates grouped by days without contact, with a suggested next step for each.

Stale Estimate Follow-Up List: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#remodeling #estimates

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/stale-estimate-follow-up?src=youtube&utm_campaign=stale-estimate-sample-walkthrough
narration: Estimates go out, the crew gets busy, and nobody follows up.
In this sample, for an invented remodeling company, seven estimates had gone quiet, worth over $92,000.
Each one gets a suggested next step. An estimate sent seventy seven days ago is flagged to confirm whether to re-quote, with no draft.
The others get a follow-up draft naming the job and estimate number, for you to send. Drafts never change your price.
